description: A ground-level photograph depicts a narrow, paved urban street or alleyway flanked by densely packed, multi-story residential buildings. The buildings show signs of age, with worn facades, some peeling paint, and visible stone masonry. On the right side of the street, multiple lines of laundry hang from building exteriors. Air conditioning units are attached to the building facades. A scooter is parked in the middle of the street in the distance. The sky is overcast. This image serves as an illustration of "Dense Urban fabric" in the context of Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) land cover classification, indicating an area with predominant residential usage.
